name: abap2ui5
description: Build abap2UI5 apps with an agent: the build-an-app, view-chain-layout, abap-check and ui5-check skills, the /abap2ui5:new-app, check, add-ai, find-sample and explain commands, an abap2ui5-reviewer subagent, a hook that runs the abap2UI5 linter on every edited class (where the project has it installed), plus the abap2UI5 MCP server (sample search, view validation, deploy, headless run and screenshot - no SAP system needed).
